title: IVE Overlay Schema
description: Single schema for any overlay, regardless of target technology. Technology-specific rules (Java today; others as they're added) are expressed as conditional (if/then) blocks below, not as separate files — one schema is enough as long as each technology's rules only activate when that technology's extensions.* key is actually present.

javaExtension.description: `basePackage` is intentionally OPTIONAL here — it can also come from `vars.basePkgPath` in ive.config.json, resolved via the `javaPackageFromPath` helper inside adapter.hbs. Whether AT LEAST ONE of these two sources supplies it can't be expressed in this schema alone (that would require checking a separate file) — enforce it in application code instead.

packages.description: e.g. { intents: '...', flow: '...', api: '...' } — per-artifact-group Java package suffixes.
